# openstatus_heartbeat_monitor (Resource)

Manages a heartbeat monitor for jobs that run on their own schedule, such as cron jobs, queue workers or backups. OpenStatus never calls the job: the job requests `ping_url` each time it runs, and the monitor goes down when a ping is late or the job requests `ping_url` followed by `/fail`.

Heartbeat monitors are being rolled out gradually. If creating one fails with "Heartbeat monitors are not available yet", contact ping@openstatus.dev to have them enabled for your workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_heartbeat_monitor" "nightly_backup" {
  name        = "Nightly backup"
  description = "Dumps the production database"
  period      = 86400 # the job runs once a day
  grace       = 1800  # and may take up to 30 minutes
  active      = true
}

# Pass the ping URL to the job, which requests it each time it runs:
#   /path/to/job.sh && curl -fsS -m 10 --retry 3 "$PING_URL" || curl -fsS -m 10 --retry 3 "$PING_URL/fail"
output "nightly_backup_ping_url" {
  value     = openstatus_heartbeat_monitor.nightly_backup.ping_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grace` (Number) Extra time after `period` before a late ping counts as missed, in seconds. Between 60 (1 minute) and 604800 (7 days). Set it to cover how long the job runs plus any start-up delay.
- `name` (String)
- `period` (Number) Expected time between pings, in seconds. Between 60 (1 minute) and 2592000 (30 days).

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is active. Pings to an inactive monitor are ignored and it sends no alerts. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String)
- `public` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive) URL the job requests each time it runs. It needs no authentication, so treat it as a secret.
